Business Development Manager (Life Insurance)

107723

Job Accountabilities

  • Be responsible for the account management of distribution partners of Life Business in Hong Kong
  • Grow the Life Business by widening the local distribution through prospecting new IFAs and brokers
  • Manage assigned accounts and generate sales growth to achieve sales target
  • Build and maintain good relationships with IFAs and brokers
  • Closely work with Distribution Support team and Underwriting team on handling NB/complicated cases
  • Support the logistics of bespoke campaigns and coordinate the broker events
  • Prepare and deliver presentation / training to IFAs and brokers to support business growth

 

Job Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree holder with relevant sales & distribution experience in insurance / financial services industry
  • We may offer Candidate the capacity of Assistant Manager to Manager, subject to their relevant experience
  • Experience in IFA Channel and/or distribution management in insurance industry is preferable
  • Experience in / exposure to bancassurance broker channel is an advantage
  • Ambitious in business growth with proven track record to build strong connection with distribution channel
  • Good understanding of financial and investment market
  • Good knowledge of traditional Life / ILAS / Premium Financing insurance products
  • Basic knowledge of underwriting principles
  • Good command of both written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin)

 

 

Why Zurich
